info.title: dotcov - Cobertura coverage toolkit
info.description: dotnet global tool that turns Cobertura XML into a build decision: coverage tables, markdown job summaries, JSON, report diffs, per-method CRAP risk, and CI gating by exit code.

options.name: --format
options.description:
Output format (default table; markdown is the long name of md)
(report, check, crap, diff, test)

options.name: --threshold
options.description:
Minimum the markdown verdict shows, 0 to 100; display only, never
the exit code
(report)

options.name: --min-line
options.description:
Minimum line coverage, 0 to 100; 0 disables the dimension
(check, test)

options.name: --min-branch
options.description: Minimum branch coverage, 0 to 100; 0 disables the dimension

options.name: --max-crap
options.description:
Highest CRAP score that passes (default 30)
(crap)

options.name: --top
options.description:
Show the N worst files (report) or methods (crap), or list at most N files below a
threshold (check, test; default 20); a gate still evaluates everything
(report, check, crap, test)

options.name: --metrics
options.description:
Cyclomatic complexity from `dotnet msbuild /t:Metrics`, for emitters
whose coverage XML does not carry it

options.name: --commit
options.description:
Commit the snapshot is stamped with (default 'unknown', warned)
(snapshot)

options.name: --branch
options.description: Branch the snapshot is stamped with (default 'unknown', warned)

options.name: --project
options.description: Project the snapshot is stamped with (default 'unknown', warned)

options.name: --exclude-generated
options.description:
Skip generated files, migrations, GlobalUsings.cs, Program.cs
(report, check, crap, diff, snapshot, test)

options.name: --exclude-test-code
options.description: Skip test projects and fixtures: *.Tests/, TestSupport/, TestFixtures/

options.name: --exclude-external
options.description:
Skip code built elsewhere: SourceLink paths (/_/...) of dependencies the coverage
tool instrumented; a warning names them when this flag is off

options.name: --keep
options.description:
Exempt comma-separated paths from the exclusions by case-insensitive
substring match, not globs; requires --exclude-generated,
--exclude-test-code, or --exclude-external (e.g. --keep Program.cs
measures a CLI tool's entry point)

options.name: --probe-sources
options.description:
Resolve a relative filename under several <source> roots against the
root that holds it on this machine's disk; the result depends on where
dotcov runs

options.name: --source-root
options.description: Resolve those filenames against this declared root instead

options.name: --pattern
options.description:
Report filename to scan directories for: 'filename' (top level only)
or '**/filename' (recursive) (default **/*cobertura*.xml)
(report, check, crap, diff, snapshot)

options.name: --max-chars
options.description: Per-file XML character cap (default 50000000; 0 = no cap)

options.name: --upload
options.description:
POST the JSON payload to an http(s) endpoint
(report, check, snapshot)

options.name: --github-summary
options.description: Append markdown to the file $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY names

options.name: --badge-dir
options.description:
Write the verdict as coverage-badge.svg and coverage-badge.json into
<dir>, created if missing, for every outcome

options.name: --no-color
options.description:
Plain output without ANSI colour, as NO_COLOR=1 gives; accepted by every command that
reads a report, so a script can pass it everywhere

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show one command's usage, options, and exit codes
(every command)
